source_reference.identity: Tan rabbit, green eyes, light blue shirt, red tie, charcoal trousers, cream tail.

method: Original PNGs retained byte-for-byte. Read-only opacity components, independent padded textures, one shared 0.70 scale for every Emre pose. Near green iris horizontally registered; floor shared. Blink landmarks interpolate. Rolls and low fallen/ash poses register body/floor, not an invented upright eye.
